zh.title: 美國航空接獲運輸部投訴將修改降等退款規則
zh.summary: 美國航空因應運輸部投訴修改降等退款規則，退款改以平均票價為基準。
body: 根據外媒 Simple Flying 報導，美國航空公司（American Airlines）在接獲美國運輸部（DOT）的投訴意見之後，目前正在著手修改其原本針對遭遇艙等降等之旅客所實施的 40% 比例退款規則。
在先前的政策中，該航空公司對於被調降艙等的旅客，僅採取退還固定百分比的簡單退款方式。然而，在新規劃的政策之下，美國航空的退款金額計算方式，現在將會以平均票價作為計算基準，而不再只是單純地退還固定比例的票價。

en.title: American Airlines Changes Downgrade Refund Policy Following DOT Complaint
en.summary: American Airlines is changing its downgrade refund rule following a US DOT complaint.
body: According to a report by Simple Flying, American Airlines is changing its existing policy that provides a flat 40% refund for passengers who experience cabin downgrades. This regulatory adjustment comes after a complaint was filed with the United States Department of Transportation (DOT) regarding the airline's refund practices.

Under the airline's previous policy, passengers who were downgraded from their booked cabin classes received a flat percentage refund of their ticket price. With the newly updated policy, American Airlines will now calculate refunds for downgraded passengers using the average fare as a baseline, rather than simply refunding a flat percentage of the ticket cost.
